log.msg: self-review (no live page available yet) caught two real bugs before any test could have: (1) windowing had no CSS enforcing ROW_H=36px on .datagrid-cell, so the scroll-position math would have drifted from what actually rendered; (2) the windowed grid's very first viewport measurement would have read the collapsed header-only height, since max-height caps but never forces a box's size -- fixed by giving .datagrid-windowed a real block-size instead (a deliberate scroll area, not a growing box). Also fixed: a null/undefined value in a chip-filtered column was being hidden by every filter state since it never had a chip to be unchecked by. Committed (e4d90cb2).
